fs_options_task_throughput_desc: AI tasks run per second. FSS default: 600. Low values make all NPCs less responsive, values below the game's own rate (80-100) mean 'auto'.
fs_options_walking_quality_desc: A character is moved at least once every 2 frames on Very high and every frame on Ultra.
fs_options_lod_updater_desc: Characters at screen center are animated better. This sets how that target is found. [requires re-entering camp from main menu]
fs_options_optimized_inputs_desc: Improved performance of code related to inputs. [requires re-entering camp from main menu]
fs_options_high_violence_mode_desc: Corpses are thrown around by explosions. For ragdolls enthusiasts.
fs_options_fastpaced_desc: Reduce significantly the pause between each enemies' actions. In short: enemies move faster.
fs_options_eyes_wide_open_desc: All NPCs are always updated 10 times per second once the alarm went off. It supersedes option 'Fast-paced game'.
fs_options_iter_chase_desc: Enemies search the next part of their path while they are still walking, so they waste less time between path segments.
fs_options_nervous_game_desc: After the alarm, enemies know who you are, spot you instantly and shoot sooner! Stealth unaffected. [requires re-entering camp from main menu]
fs_options_improved_tactics_desc: Assaulting enemies move from cover to cover, crouch in dangerous places and avoid places where their comrades just died. Requires Iter RAID.
fs_options_cop_awareness_desc: Enemies face danger more and keep firing while walking. [requires re-entering camp from main menu]
